question:
In an election between two candidates, 80% of the voters cast their votes, out of which 4% votes were declared invalid. A candidate got 15,360 votes which were 80% of the valid votes. Find the total number of votes.

(CGL 2024 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 25,000.

Total votes = x
\(\therefore\) \(x\times\frac{4}{5}\times\frac{24}{25}\times\frac{4}{5}\) = 15360
x × \(\frac{24}{25\times25}\) = 960 
x = 40 × 25 × 25 = 25000
question_hi:

(CGL 2024 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात 25,000 है।

कुल वोट= x
\(\therefore\) \( x\times\frac{4}{5}\times\frac{24}{25}\times\frac{4}{5}\) = 15360
x × \(\frac{24}{25\times25}\) = 960 
x = 40 × 25 × 25 = 25000

question:
Hari, Kamal and Lalit contested an election in which 6050 votes were polled and none of the votes were invalid. Kamal got 42% more votes than the total votes obtained by Hari and Lalit together. If Lalit obtained only 8% of the total polled votes, find the number of votes obtained by Hari.

(CGL 2023 Mains)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 2016.

Kamal    :    Hari + Lalit

       71    :    50

121 unit → ×50 → 6050

Hari got = 2500 - 484 = 2016

कमल       :· हरि + ललित
     142    :    100
       71    :    50

121 unit → ×50 → 6050

50 unit → ×50 → 2500

∴ हरि और ललित को मिले = 2500

ललित को मिला = 8/100 × 6050 = 484
हरि को मिल गया = 2500 - 484 = 2016

question:
In an election between two candidates, 30% of the electorate did not cast their votes. 20% of the votes polled were found invalid. The winning candidate got 64% of the valid votes and won by a majority of 3136 votes. Find the number of voters enrolled in the voter list.

(CPO 2023 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 20000.

15.68 unit → ×200 → 3136
100 unit → ×200 → 20,000
Let number of votes = x
Votes casted = \(x\ \times\frac{70}{100}=\frac{7x}{10}\)
Valid votes = \(\frac{7x}{10}\times\frac{80}{100}=\frac{7x}{10}\times\frac{4}{5}\) 
Winning candidate get 64% and loser get 36% 
Winning margin = 64% - 36% = 28%

\(\frac{7x}{10}\times\frac{4}{5}\times\frac{28}{100}\) = 3136
\(\frac{7x}{10}\times\frac{4}{5}\times\frac{1}{100}\) = 112 
\(\frac{x}{50}\times\frac{1}{100}\) = 4
x = 20000
question_hi:
दो उम्मीदवारों के बीच हुए चुनाव में. 30% मतदाताओं ने अपना मत नहीं डाला। डाले गए 20% मत अवैध पाए गए। विजयी उम्मीदवार को 64% वैध मत मिले और वह 3136 मतों के बहुमत से जीत गया। मतदाता सूची में नामांकित मतदाताओं की संख्या ज्ञात करें।

(CPO 2023 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात 20000 है।

15.68 unit → ×200 → 3136
100 unit → ×200 → 20,000
माना वोटों की संख्या = x
डाले गए वोट = \(x\ \times\frac{70}{100}=\frac{7x}{10}\)
वैध वोट = \(\frac{7x}{10}\times\frac{80}{100}=\frac{7x}{10}\times\frac{4}{5}\)
विजेता उम्मीदवार को 64% और हारने वाले को 36% वोट मिलेंगे
जीत का अंतर = 64% - 36% = 28%

\(\frac{7x}{10}\times\frac{4}{5}\times\frac{28}{100}\) = 3136
\(\frac{7x}{10}\times\frac{4}{5}\times\frac{1}{100}\) = 112 
\(\frac{x}{50}\times\frac{1}{100}\) = 4
x = 20000

question:
In an election, the winner was supported by 46% of all the voters in the list, and he got 410 votes more than his only rival. 10% of the voters on the voters' list did not cast their votes, and 60 voters cast their ballot papers blank. How many voters were on the list?

(СРО 2024 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 17500.

Let the voters in the voting list be 100x
The number of voters who cast their votes = 100x × \(\frac{90}{100}\) = 90x 
Invalid votes = 60
Valid votes = 90x - 60 
The number of votes of winner = 100x × \(\frac{46}{100}\) = 46x
The number of votes of losers  = (90x - 60) - 46x 
= 44x - 60 
Winning votes 
⇒ 46x - (44x - 60) = 410
⇒ 2x + 60 = 410 = 410-60
⇒ 2x = 350
⇒ x = 175
Total no. of votes in the voting list = 100x = 17500
question_hi:
एक चुनाव में, विजेता को सूची में शामिल सभी मतदाताओं में से 46% का समर्थन प्राप्त था, और उसे अपने एकमात्र प्रतिद्वंद्वी से 410 वोट अधिक मिले। मतदाता सूची में शामिल 10% मतदाताओं ने अपना वोट नहीं डाला, और 60 मतदाताओं ने अपने मतपत्र खाली डाले। सूची में कितने मतदाता थे?

(СРО 2024 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात 17500 है।

मान लें कि मतदान सूची में मतदाताओं की संख्या 100x है
मतदान करने वाले मतदाताओं की संख्या = 100x × \(\frac{90}{100}\) = 90x
अमान्य मत = 60
वैध मत = 90x - 60
विजेता के मतों की संख्या = 100x × \(\frac{46}{100}\) = 46x
हारने वालों के मतों की संख्या = (90x - 60) - 46x
= 44x - 60
विजेता मत
⇒ 46x - (44x - 60) = 410
⇒ 2x + 60 = 410 = 410-60
⇒ 2x = 350
⇒ x = 175
मतदान सूची में कुल मतों की संख्या = 100x = 17500

question:

solution:

↓

= 12.5% + 5% 
= 17.5%

= 25% + 17.5%
= 42.5%

solution_hi:

↓
25% R + 25% S

question:

question:
The population of town B is 300% more than that of town A. For next two years, the population of A increased by x% per year and that of B decreases by the same percentage per year. After 2 years, if the population of A and B become equal, then the value of x is ___.

(CPO 2019 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 33\(\frac{1}{3}\).

             A    :     B
Ratio = 1    :    4
1 ×\(\frac{100\ +\ x}{100}\times\frac{100\ +\ x}{100}\) = 4 × \(\frac{100 - x}{100} \times \frac{100 - x}{100}\)

(100 + x)2 = 4 × (100 - x)2
10000 + x2 + 200x = 4(10000+x2 -200x) 
10000 + x2+ 200x =40000+4 x2- 800x 
1000x = 3x2+ 30000
3x2 - 1000x + 30000 = 0
3x2 - (900 + 100) × x + 30000 = 0 
3x2 - 900x - 100x + 30000 = 0 
3x(x - 300) - 100(x - 300) = 0 
(x - 300)(3x - 100) = 0 

x = 300 
x = \(\frac{100}{3} \) = \(33\frac{\mathbf{1}}{\mathbf{3}}\)
